title: Farzi
hook: Before Farzi Season 2: Sunny, a street artist turned counterfeiter, is in custody after STF officer Mansoor ran him to ground in the Season 1 finale. Here is what happened in Season 1.

sections.heading: What Sunny built and why
sections.body: Shahid Kapoor's Sunny is a street artist with a grandfather who taught him printing as craft. When he discovers how the counterfeit currency economy works, he applies his art skills to the operation - making fake notes that are close enough to real. Farzi pairs his ascent with Vijay Sethupathi's Mansoor, an STF officer whose obsessive tracking mirrors Sunny's confidence. The series, directed by Raj and DK, pairs tonal fluency (comedy, crime, thriller) in a way that made it the most-watched Hindi web series of 2023, with a reported 37.1 million viewers.

sections.heading: The collapse: a tracker, a Fortuner, a room
sections.body: The Season 1 finale's key event is Sunny removing a tracking device from Megha's phone - a decision made to protect her that removed his early-warning system. A white Fortuner is traced on a phone call. Police close in. Fake currency spills from a moving car. Every escape route narrows. Firoz panics. Sunny finally faces Mansoor in a room where the swagger is gone and the damage of every choice is visible. Season 1 ends with Sunny in custody.

need_to_know.q: Where does Farzi Season 2 pick up?
need_to_know.a: Season 1 ends with Sunny in STF custody after being cornered in the finale. Season 2 picks up from that point, though no episode details are available as production was ongoing as of June 2026.

need_to_know.q: Who are the main characters in Farzi?
need_to_know.a: Sunny (Shahid Kapoor), a street artist who builds a counterfeit currency operation. Mansoor (Vijay Sethupathi), the STF officer pursuing him. The two are the cat-and-mouse axis of Season 1.
